item.title: ASÍ FUE EL CHOQUE DE TRENES QUE CONMOCIONÓ A ESPAÑA Una reconstrucción realizada con inteligencia artificial recrea el impacto entre dos trenes de alta velocidad en Urda, Toledo, que dejó 69 muertos y alrededor de 200 heridos. A seis días de la tragedia, la investigación busca determinar cómo una falla en el sistema de seguridad ferroviaria y una serie de órdenes desde el centro de control permitieron que un tren AVE de Renfe impactara contra una formación de Iryo que permanecía detenida sobre las vías. En medio de las repercusiones políticas, el ministro de Transportes español, Óscar Puente, anunció su renuncia durante una comparecencia en el Congreso. Además, el Gobierno aprobó un paquete de 30 millones de euros en ayudas para las víctimas y sus familiares. | LA NACION

item.title: ‘The Cat in the Hat’ Review: Bill Hader Leads an Animated Dr. Seuss Comedy So Overstuffed It’s Like a Marvel Movie for Tots
item.description: The new "Cat in the Hat," it goes without saying at this point, makes no attempt to be a faithful adaptation of Dr. Seuss’s most fabled books. That would simply be too quaint for our buzzy, mercurial, attention-crashing, video-games-on-Ritalin era. Yet even as the movie departs all too eagerly from the innocent wildness of the Seuss books, it devotes itself, with a corporate diligence that’s the opposite of free-spirited, to mimicking the scale and spirit and plot setups of too many familiar blockbusters. It’s a mish-mosh of pop recycling. Fuente: Variety.

item.title: Crossings: Laura Pannack’s award-winning images of South African youth – in pictures
item.description: The British visual artist and photographer Laura Pannack has been named the winner of the inaugural Tom Stoddart award for excellence 2025. A collaboration between Gost Books and the Ian Parry photojournalism grant , the award supports photographers engaged in long-form documentary work. South Africa has one of the world’s highest levels of social inequality and a rapidly growing youth population; Pannack’s project Crossings looks at the journey to and from school and its physical and psychological challenges for young people Crossings by Laura Pannack is available now Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.description: The Jojo Rabbit director blamed the dismal numbers for his film of Kazuo Ishiguro’s novel on ‘obsolete’ reviewers’ notices, adding that he works ‘for the people’ – whose Rotten Tomatoes ratings are much higher Taika Waititi has launched a furious broadside at “critics” following the disastrous commercial performance of Klara and the Sun, his new film adapted from a Kazuo Ishiguro novel. item.title: ‘They said we incited riots’: explosive punks Bad Brains on drugs, self-destruction and recording from jail
item.description: Young, black and fuelled by self-help mantras, they were reputedly the best live band on Earth.
